elements.requirement: Sections 91 to 108 (assignment and subletting, repairs and improvements, variation of terms, provision of information and consultation, contributions to costs of transfers and heating charges) do not apply to a tenancy when the landlord's interest belongs to a co-operative housing association.
elements.quote: do not apply to a tenancy when the interest of the landlord belongs to a co-operative housing association
